name: lead-enrichment-form
title: Lead Enrichment Form
description: Ballet starter: live streaming lead enrichment demo with AI SDK generative UI, step cards, and Import / Sign up CTAs.
author: Ballet <https://ballet.dev>

files.content:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="172" height="36" viewBox="0 0 172 36" role="img" aria-label="Import to Ballet">
  <title>Import to Ballet</title>
  <rect width="172" height="36" rx="8" fill="#0a0a0a"/>
  <rect x="0.5" y="0.5" width="171" height="35" rx="7.5" fill="none" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-opacity="0.18"/>
  <g fill="none" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
    <path d="M18 11v10"/>
    <path d="M13.5 17l4.5 4.5L22.5 17"/>
    <path d="M12 25h12"/>
  </g>
  <text x="36" y="23" fill="#ffffff" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13.5" font-weight="600">Import to Ballet</text>
</svg>

# Optional: override the public Ballet demo SSE endpoint (server proxy).
# Default: https://ballet.dev/api/demo/enrich
# NEXT_PUBLIC_BALLET_DEMO_URL is read as a fallback for the same value.
# BALLET_DEMO_URL=https://ballet.dev/api/demo/enrich
# NEXT_PUBLIC_BALLET_DEMO_URL=https://ballet.dev/api/demo/enrich

# Optional bring-your-own Ballet workflow (skips the public demo).
# Workspace API token from Ballet Studio → Settings → API tokens (mt_live_…).
# Sent as: Authorization: Bearer <value>
# Ballet docs call this BALLET_API_TOKEN; this starter uses BALLET_API_KEY for the same value.
BALLET_API_KEY=mt_live_your_workspace_token

# Full URL to trigger your published playbook.
# Preferred (REST execute, SSE stream ending in run_stop):
#   https://api.ballet.dev/api/playbooks/<PLAYBOOK_ID>/execute
# Body sent: { "input": { "lead_id", "company", "email", "title", "name", "website", "message" } }
#
# Also supported:
#   https://api.ballet.dev/api/playbooks/<PLAYBOOK_ID>/run   (returns { runId })
#   https://api.ballet.dev/api/webhooks/<path>              (webhook body is the input object)
BALLET_WORKFLOW_URL=https://api.ballet.dev/api/playbooks/YOUR_PLAYBOOK_ID/execute
